name: Bard
description: Bards are the most charismatic people in all the realms. Members of this class are masters of captivation and specialize in a variety of performance types, including singing, playing musical instruments, weaving tales, or telling jokes. Whether performing for an audience or speaking to an individual, bards thrive in social situations.

Members of this profession bond and train at schools or guilds, but a current of egotism runs through those of the bardic persuasion. While they may be the most likely class to bring people together, a bard of ill temper can just as easily tear a party apart.
items: A romance novel or a letter never opened
hopeFeature: Make a Scene: Spend 3 Hope to temporarily Distract a target within Close range, giving them a -2 penalty to their Difficulty.

classFeatures.name: Rally
classFeatures.description: Once per session, describe how you rally the party and give yourself and each of your allies a Rally Die. At level 1, your Rally Die is a d6. A PC can spend their Rally Die to roll it, adding the result to their action roll, reaction roll, damage roll, or to clear a number of Stress equal to the result. At the end of each session, clear all unspent Rally Dice. At level 5, your Rally Die increases to a d8.

foundation.name: Gifted Performer
foundation.description: You can play three different types of songs, once each per long rest; describe how you perform for others to gain the listed benefit. Relaxing Song: You and all allies within Close range clear a Hit Point. Epic Song: Make a target within Close range temporarily Vulnerable. Heartbreaking Song: You and all allies within Close range gain a Hope.

specialization.name: Maestro
specialization.description: Your rallying songs steel the courage of those who listen. When you give a Rally Die to an ally, they can gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

mastery.name: Virtuoso
mastery.description: Your Rally Die increases to a d10. You are among the greatest of your craft. Each of your Gifted Performer songs can be performed twice per long rest.

foundation.name: Rousing Speech
foundation.description: Once per long rest, you can give a heartfelt, inspiring speech. All allies within Far range clear 2 Stress.

foundation.name: Heart of a Poet
foundation.description: After you make an action roll to impress, persuade, or offend someone, you can spend a Hope to add a d4 to the roll.

specialization.name: Eloquent
specialization.description: Your moving words boost morale. Once per session, when you encourage an ally, you can do one of the following: Allow them to find a mundane object or tool they need. Help an Ally without spending Hope. Give them an additional downtime move during their next rest.

mastery.name: Epic Poetry
mastery.description: Your Rally Die increases to a d10. Additionally, when you Help an Ally, you can narrate the moment as if writing the tale of their heroism in a memoir. When you do, roll a d10 as your advantage die.

backgroundQuestions: Who from your community taught you to have such confidence in yourself?
You were in love once. Who did you adore, and how did they hurt you?
You've always looked up to another bard. Who are they, and why do you idolize them?
connectionQuestions: What made you realize we were going to be such good friends?
What do I do that annoys you?
Why do you grab my hand at night?

name: Druid
description: Becoming a druid is more than an occupation; it's a calling for those who wish to learn from and protect the magic of the wilderness. While one might underestimate a gentle druid who practices the often-quiet work of cultivating flora, druids who channel the untamed forces of nature are terrifying to behold.

Druids cultivate their abilities in small groups, often connected by a specific ethos or locale, but some choose to work alone. Through years of study and dedication, druids can learn to transform into beasts and shape nature itself.
items: A small bag of rocks and bones or a strange pendant found in the dirt
hopeFeature: Evolution: Spend 3 Hope to transform into a Beastform without marking a Stress. When you do, choose one trait to raise by +1 until you drop out of that Beastform.

classFeatures.name: Beastform
classFeatures.description: Mark a Stress to magically transform into a creature of your tier or lower from the Beastform list. You can drop out of this form at any time. While transformed, you can't use weapons or cast spells from domain cards, but you can still use other features or abilities you have access to. Spells you cast before you transform stay active and last for their normal duration, and you can talk and communicate as normal. Additionally, you gain the Beastform's features, add their Evasion bonus to your Evasion, and use the trait specified in their statistics for your attack. While in a Beastform, your armor becomes part of your body and you mark Armor Slots as usual; when you drop out, those marked slots remain marked. If you mark your last Hit Point, you automatically drop out of this form.

classFeatures.name: Wildtouch
classFeatures.description: You can perform harmless, subtle effects that involve nature, such as causing a flower to rapidly grow, summoning a slight gust of wind, or starting a campfire, at will.

foundation.name: Elemental Incarnation
foundation.description: Mark a Stress to Channel one of the following elements until you take Severe damage or until your next rest. Fire: When an adversary within Melee range deals damage to you, they take 1d10 magic damage. Earth: Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency. Water: When you deal damage to an adversary within Melee range, all other adversaries within Very Close range must mark a Stress. Air: You can hover, gaining advantage on Agility Rolls.

specialization.name: Elemental Aura
specialization.description: Once per rest while Channeling, you can assume an aura matching your element affecting targets within Close range. Fire: When an adversary marks 1 or more Hit Points, they must also mark a Stress. Earth: Your allies gain a +1 bonus to Strength. Water: When an adversary deals damage to you, mark a Stress to move them anywhere within Very Close range. Air: When you or an ally takes damage from beyond Melee range, reduce the damage by 1d8.

mastery.name: Elemental Dominion
mastery.description: While Channeling, you gain an additional benefit per element. Fire: Gain +1 to Proficiency for attacks and spells that deal damage. Earth: When you would mark Hit Points, roll a d6 per Hit Point marked; each result of 6 reduces the Hit Points marked by 1. Water: When an attack against you succeeds, mark a Stress to make the attacker temporarily Vulnerable. Air: Gain +1 to Evasion and you can fly.

foundation.name: Clarity of Nature
foundation.description: Once per long rest, create a space of natural serenity within Close range. When you spend a few minutes resting within the space, clear Stress equal to your Instinct, distributed as you choose between you and your allies.

foundation.name: Regeneration
foundation.description: Touch a creature and spend 3 Hope. That creature clears 1d4 Hit Points.

specialization.name: Regenerative Reach
specialization.description: You can target creatures within Very Close range with your Regeneration feature.

specialization.name: Warden's Protection
specialization.description: Once per long rest, spend 2 Hope to clear 2 Hit Points on 1d4 allies within Close range.

mastery.name: Defender
mastery.description: When you're in Beastform and an ally within Close range marks 2 or more Hit Points, you can mark a Stress to reduce the number of Hit Points they mark by 1.

backgroundQuestions: Why was the community you grew up in so reliant on nature and its creatures?
Who was the first wild animal you bonded with? Why did your bond end?
Who has been trying to hunt you down? What do they want from you?
connectionQuestions: What did you confide in me that makes me leap into danger for you every time?
What animal do I say you remind me of?
What affectionate nickname have you given me?

name: Guardian
description: The title of guardian represents an array of martial professions, speaking more to their moral compass and unshakeable fortitude than the means by which they fight. While many guardians join groups of militants for either a country or cause, they're more likely to follow those few they truly care for, majority be damned.

Guardians are known for fighting with remarkable ferocity even against overwhelming odds, defending their cohort above all else. Woe betide those who harm the ally of a guardian, as the guardian will answer this injury in kind.
items: A totem from your mentor or a secret key
hopeFeature: Frontline Tank: Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Armor Slots.

classFeatures.name: Unstoppable
classFeatures.description: Once per long rest, you can become Unstoppable. You gain an Unstoppable Die (d4 at level 1, d6 at level 5). Place it on your character sheet starting with the 1 value facing up. After you make a damage roll that deals 1 or more Hit Points to a target, increase the die value by one. When the value would exceed its maximum or the scene ends, remove the die and drop out of Unstoppable. While Unstoppable: reduce the severity of physical damage by one threshold; add the current die value to your damage roll; you can't be Restrained or Vulnerable.

foundation.name: Unwavering
foundation.description: You gain a permanent +1 bonus to all damage thresholds.

foundation.name: Iron Will
foundation.description: When you take physical damage, you can mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage by one threshold.

specialization.name: Unrelenting
specialization.description: You gain a permanent +2 bonus to all damage thresholds.

specialization.name: Partners-in-Arms
specialization.description: When an ally within Very Close range takes damage, you can mark an Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage by one threshold.

mastery.name: Undaunted
mastery.description: You gain a permanent +3 bonus to all damage thresholds.

mastery.name: Loyal Protector
mastery.description: When an ally within Close range has 2 or fewer Hit Points remaining and would take damage, you can mark a Stress to sprint to their side and take the damage instead.

foundation.name: At Ease
foundation.description: You gain an additional Stress slot.

foundation.name: Revenge
foundation.description: When an adversary within Melee range succeeds on an attack against you, you can mark 2 Stress to force the attacker to mark a Hit Point.

specialization.name: Act of Reprisal
specialization.description: When an adversary damages an ally within Melee range of you, gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for your next successful attack against that adversary.

mastery.name: Nemesis
mastery.description: Spend 2 Hope to Prioritize an adversary until your next rest. When making an attack against your Prioritized adversary, you can swap the results of your Hope and Fear Dice. Only one adversary can be Prioritized at a time.

backgroundQuestions: Who from your community did you fail to protect, and why do you still think of them?
You've been tasked with protecting something important and delivering it somewhere dangerous. What is it, and where does it need to go?
You consider an aspect of yourself to be a weakness. What is it, and how has it affected you?
connectionQuestions: How did I save your life the first time we met?
What small gift did you give me that you notice I always carry with me?
What lie have you told me about yourself that I absolutely believe?

name: Ranger
description: Rangers are highly skilled hunters who, despite their martial abilities, rarely lend their skills to an army. Through mastery of the body and a deep understanding of the wilderness, rangers become sly tacticians, pursuing their quarry with cunning and patience.

Many rangers track and fight alongside an animal companion with whom they've forged a powerful spiritual bond. By honing their skills in the wild, rangers become expert trackers, as likely to ensnare their foes in a trap as they are to assail them head-on.
items: A trophy from your first kill or a seemingly broken compass
hopeFeature: Hold Them Off: Spend 3 Hope when you succeed on an attack with a weapon to use that same roll against two additional adversaries within range of the attack.

classFeatures.name: Ranger's Focus
classFeatures.description: Spend a Hope and make an attack against a target. On a success, deal your attack's normal damage and temporarily make the target your Focus. Until this feature ends or you make a different creature your Focus, you gain the following benefits against your Focus: You know precisely what direction they are in. When you deal damage to them, they must mark a Stress. When you fail an attack against them, you can end your Ranger's Focus to reroll your Duality Dice.

foundation.name: Companion
foundation.description: You have a loyal animal companion. Take the Ranger Companion sheet. Your companion starts with Evasion 10 and two Experiences at +2. Their attack deals d6 physical damage at Melee range. Command your companion with a Spellcast Roll; spend Hope to add a Companion Experience to the roll. Your companion marks Stress instead of Hit Points; if their last Stress is marked they drop out and return at your next long rest with 1 Stress cleared.

specialization.name: Expert Training
specialization.description: Choose an additional level-up option for your companion.

specialization.name: Battle-Bonded
specialization.description: When an adversary attacks you while your companion is within their Melee range, gain +2 to your Evasion against that attack.

mastery.name: Advanced Training
mastery.description: Choose two additional level-up options for your companion.

mastery.name: Loyal Friend
mastery.description: Once per long rest, when damage would mark your companion's last Stress or your last Hit Point and you're within Close range of each other, you or your companion can rush to the other's side and take the damage instead.

foundation.name: Ruthless Predator
foundation.description: When you make a damage roll, you can mark a Stress to gain +1 Proficiency for that roll. When you deal Severe damage to an adversary, they must mark a Stress.

foundation.name: Path Forward
foundation.description: When traveling to a place you've previously been or carrying an object from that location, you can identify the shortest, most direct path to get there.

specialization.name: Elusive Predator
specialization.description: When your Focus makes an attack against you, gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against that attack.

mastery.name: Apex Predator
mastery.description: Before making an attack roll against your Focus, spend a Hope. On a successful attack, remove a Fear from the GM's Fear pool.

backgroundQuestions: A terrible creature hurt your community, and you've vowed to hunt them down. What are they, and what unique trail or sign do they leave behind?
Your first kill almost killed you, too. What was it, and what part of you was never the same after that event?
You've traveled many dangerous lands, but what is the one place you refuse to go?
connectionQuestions: What friendly competition do we have?
Why do you act differently when we're alone than when others are around?
What threat have you asked me to watch for, and why are you worried about it?

name: Rogue
description: Rogues are scoundrels, often in both attitude and practice. Broadly known as liars and thieves, the best among this class move through the world anonymously. Utilizing their sharp wits and blades, rogues trick their foes through social manipulation as easily as breaking locks, climbing through windows, or dealing underhanded blows.

These masters of magical craft manipulate shadow and movement, adding an array of useful and deadly tools to their repertoire. Rogues frequently establish guilds to meet future accomplices, hire out jobs, and hone secret skills, proving that there's honor among thieves for those who know where to look.
items: A set of forgery tools or a grappling hook
hopeFeature: Rogue's Dodge: Spend 3 Hope to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion until the next time an attack succeeds against you. Otherwise, this bonus lasts until your next rest.

classFeatures.name: Cloaked
classFeatures.description: Any time you would be Hidden, you are instead Cloaked. In addition to the benefits of the Hidden condition, while Cloaked you remain unseen if you are stationary when an adversary moves to where they would normally see you. After you make an attack or end a move within line of sight of an adversary, you are no longer Cloaked.

classFeatures.name: Sneak Attack
classFeatures.description: When you succeed on an attack while Cloaked or while an ally is within Melee range of your target, add a number of d6s equal to your tier to your damage roll. (Tier 1 at level 1, Tier 2 at levels 2-4, Tier 3 at levels 5-7, Tier 4 at levels 8-10.)

foundation.name: Shadow Stepper
foundation.description: Mark a Stress when moving into an area of darkness or a shadow to teleport to another shadow within Far range, arriving Cloaked.

specialization.name: Dark Cloud
specialization.description: Make a Spellcast Roll (15) to create a dark cloud covering an area within Close range. Those inside the cloud can't see out and those outside can't see in. You are Cloaked from adversaries whose line of sight is blocked by the cloud.

specialization.name: Adrenaline
specialization.description: While you are Vulnerable, add your level to all damage rolls.

mastery.name: Fleeting Shadow
mastery.description: You gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion. The range of Shadow Stepper extends to Very Far range.

mastery.name: Vanishing Act
mastery.description: Mark a Stress to become Cloaked at any time (this also automatically clears the Restrained condition). You remain Cloaked until you roll with Fear or until your next rest.

foundation.name: Well-Connected
foundation.description: When you arrive in a prominent town or environment, you know somebody there. Give them a name, note their usefulness, and choose one fact: they owe you a favor (but are hard to find), they'll ask for something in exchange, they're always in trouble, you used to be together romantically, or you didn't part on great terms.

specialization.name: Contacts Everywhere
specialization.description: Once per session, briefly call on a shady contact for one benefit: 1 handful of gold, a unique tool, or a mundane object; a +3 bonus to your next roll's Hope or Fear Die; or add 2d8 to your next damage roll.

mastery.name: Reliable Backup
mastery.description: Contacts Everywhere can be used three times per session. Additional options: when you mark 1 or more Hit Points, a contact can reduce it by 1; when making a Presence Roll in conversation, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

backgroundQuestions: What did you get caught doing that got you exiled from your home community?
You used to have a different life, but you've tried to leave it behind. Who from your past is still chasing you?
Who from your past were you most sad to say goodbye to?
connectionQuestions: What did I recently convince you to do that got us both in trouble?
What have I discovered about your past that I hold secret from the others?
Who do you know from my past, and how have they influenced your feelings about me?

name: Seraph
description: Seraphs are divine fighters and healers imbued with sacred purpose. A wide array of deities exist within the realms, and thus numerous kinds of seraphs are appointed by these gods. Their ethos traditionally aligns with the domain or goals of their god, such as defending the weak, exacting vengeance, protecting a land or artifact, or upholding a particular faith.

Some seraphs ally themselves with an army or locale, much to the satisfaction of their rulers, but other crusaders fight in opposition to the follies of the Mortal Realm. It is better to be a seraph's ally than their enemy, as they are terrifying foes to those who defy their purpose.
items: A bundle of offerings or a sigil of your god
hopeFeature: Life Support: Spend 3 Hope to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.

classFeatures.name: Prayer Dice
classFeatures.description: At the beginning of each session, roll a number of d4s equal to your subclass's Spellcast trait and place them on your character sheet. These are your Prayer Dice. You can spend any number of Prayer Dice to aid yourself or an ally within Far range. Use a spent die's value to reduce incoming damage, add to a roll's result after the roll is made, or gain Hope equal to the result. At the end of each session, clear all unspent Prayer Dice.

foundation.name: Spirit Weapon
foundation.description: An equipped Melee or Very Close weapon can fly to attack an adversary within Close range and return to you. Mark a Stress to target an additional adversary with the same attack.

foundation.name: Sparing Touch
foundation.description: Once per long rest, touch a creature to clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress.

specialization.name: Devout
specialization.description: When rolling Prayer Dice at the start of a session, roll an additional die and discard the lowest result. Sparing Touch can now be used twice per long rest.

mastery.name: Sacred Resonance
mastery.description: When you roll damage for Spirit Weapon, if any damage dice results match, double the value of each matching die (for example, two 5s become two 10s).

foundation.name: Wings of Light
foundation.description: You can fly. While flying, you can mark a Stress to carry another willing creature of approximately your size or smaller. While flying, spend a Hope to deal an extra 1d8 damage on a successful attack.

specialization.name: Ethereal Visage
specialization.description: While flying, you have advantage on Presence Rolls. When you succeed with Hope on a Presence Roll, you can remove a Fear from the GM's Fear pool instead of gaining Hope.

mastery.name: Ascendant
mastery.description: You gain a permanent +4 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

mastery.name: Power of the Gods
mastery.description: While flying, your Wings of Light feature deals an extra 1d12 damage instead of 1d8.

backgroundQuestions: Which god did you devote yourself to? What incredible feat did they perform for you in a moment of desperation?
How did your appearance change after taking your oath?
In what strange or unique way do you communicate with your god?
connectionQuestions: What promise did you make me agree to, should you die on the battlefield?
Why do you ask me so many questions about my god?
You've told me to protect one member of our party above all others, even yourself. Who are they and why?

name: Sorcerer
description: Not all innate magic users choose to hone their craft, but those who do can become powerful sorcerers. The gifts of these wielders are passed down through families, even if the family is unaware of or reluctant to practice them. A sorcerer's abilities can range from the elemental to the illusionary and beyond, and many practitioners band together into collectives based on their talents.

The act of becoming a formidable sorcerer is not the practice of acquiring power, but learning to cultivate and control the power one already possesses. The magic of a misguided or undisciplined sorcerer is a dangerous force indeed.
items: A whispering orb or a family heirloom
hopeFeature: Volatile Magic: Spend 3 Hope to reroll any number of your damage dice on an attack that deals magic damage.

classFeatures.name: Arcane Sense
classFeatures.description: You can sense the presence of magical people and objects within Close range.

classFeatures.name: Minor Illusion
classFeatures.description: Make a Spellcast Roll (10). On a success, you create a minor visual illusion no larger than yourself within Close range. This illusion is convincing to anyone at Close range or farther.

classFeatures.name: Channel Raw Power
classFeatures.description: Once per long rest, you can place a domain card from your loadout into your vault and choose to either: Gain Hope equal to the level of the card, or enhance a spell that deals damage, gaining a bonus to your damage roll equal to twice the level of the card.

foundation.name: Elementalist
foundation.description: Choose one element: air, earth, fire, lightning, or water. You can shape it into harmless effects at will. Spend a Hope to help any action roll involving your element: gain a +2 bonus to the roll or a +3 bonus to damage.

specialization.name: Natural Evasion
specialization.description: When an attack roll against you succeeds, you can mark a Stress to roll a d6 and add the result to your Evasion against that attack.

mastery.name: Transcendence
mastery.description: Once per long rest, transform into a physical manifestation of your element. Until your next rest, choose two of the following benefits: +4 to your Severe threshold, +1 to a character trait, +1 to Proficiency, +2 to Evasion.

foundation.name: Manipulate Magic
foundation.description: After casting a spell or making a magic damage attack, mark a Stress to do one of the following: extend the spell's reach by one range; gain +2 to the action roll's result; double a damage die of your choice; or hit an additional target within range.

specialization.name: Enchanted Aid
specialization.description: When you Help an Ally with a Spellcast Roll, roll a d8 as your advantage die. Once per long rest after an ally makes a Spellcast Roll with your help, you can swap the results of their Duality Dice.

mastery.name: Arcane Charge
mastery.description: When you take magic damage, become Charged. Or spend 2 Hope to become Charged. When you successfully attack with magic damage while Charged, clear your Charge to either gain +10 to damage or gain +3 to the Difficulty of a reaction roll the spell causes.

backgroundQuestions: What did you do that made the people in your community wary of you?
What mentor taught you to control your untamed magic, and why are they no longer able to guide you?
You have a deep fear you hide from everyone. What is it, and why does it scare you?
connectionQuestions: Why do you trust me so deeply?
What did I do that makes you cautious around me?
Why do we keep our shared past a secret?

name: Warrior
description: Becoming a warrior requires years, often a lifetime, of training and dedication to the mastery of weapons and violence. While many who seek to fight hone only their strength, warriors understand the importance of an agile body and mind, making them some of the most sought-after fighters across the realms.

Frequently, warriors find employment within an army, a band of mercenaries, or even a royal guard, but their potential is wasted in any position where they cannot continue to improve and expand their skills. Warriors are known to have a favored weapon; to come between them and their blade would be a grievous mistake.
items: The drawing of a lover or a sharpening stone
hopeFeature: No Mercy: Spend 3 Hope to gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls until your next rest.

classFeatures.name: Attack of Opportunity
classFeatures.description: If an adversary within Melee range attempts to leave that range, make a reaction roll using a trait of your choice against their Difficulty. On a success, choose one effect; on a critical success, choose two: they can't move from where they are; you deal damage to them equal to your primary weapon's damage; or you move with them.

classFeatures.name: Combat Training
classFeatures.description: You ignore burden when equipping weapons. When you deal physical damage, you gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to your level.

foundation.name: Courage
foundation.description: When you fail a roll with Fear, you gain a Hope.

foundation.name: Battle Ritual
foundation.description: Once per long rest, before something incredibly dangerous or when facing a clearly superior foe, describe your ritual or mental preparations. Clear 2 Stress and gain 2 Hope.

specialization.name: Rise to the Challenge
specialization.description: While you have 2 or fewer Hit Points remaining and unmarked, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

mastery.name: Camaraderie
mastery.description: You can initiate a Tag Team Roll one additional time per session. When an ally initiates a Tag Team Roll with you, they only need to spend 2 Hope instead of 3.

foundation.name: Slayer
foundation.description: Gain a pool of Slayer Dice. On any roll with Hope, place a d6 in your Slayer pool instead of gaining Hope. You can store up to your Proficiency in Slayer Dice. When making an attack or damage roll, spend any number of Slayer Dice to roll and add them. At the end of each session, clear all unspent Slayer Dice and gain 1 Hope per die cleared.

specialization.name: Weapon Specialist
specialization.description: Spend a Hope after a successful attack to add one damage die from your secondary weapon to the damage roll. Once per long rest when rolling Slayer Dice, reroll any dice that show a 1.

mastery.name: Martial Preparation
mastery.description: Your party gains access to the Martial Preparation downtime move. Describe instructing and training with your party; you and each participating ally gain a d6 Slayer Die that can be used on any attack or damage roll.

backgroundQuestions: Who taught you to fight, and why did they stay behind when you left home?
Somebody defeated you in battle years ago and left you to die. Who was it, and how did they betray you?
What legendary place have you always wanted to visit, and why is it so special?
connectionQuestions: We knew each other long before this party came together. How?
What mundane task do you usually help me with off the battlefield?
What fear am I helping you overcome?

name: Wizard
description: Whether through an institution or individual study, those known as wizards acquire and hone immense magical power over years of learning using a variety of tools, including books, stones, potions, and herbs. Some wizards dedicate their lives to mastering a particular school of magic, while others learn from a wide variety of disciplines.

Many wizards become wise and powerful figures in their communities, advising rulers, providing medicines and healing, and even leading war councils. While these mages all work toward the common goal of collecting magical knowledge, wizards often have the most conflict within their own ranks, as the acquisition, keeping, and sharing of powerful secrets is a topic of intense debate that has resulted in innumerable deaths.
items: A book you're trying to translate or a tiny, harmless elemental pet
hopeFeature: Not This Time: Spend 3 Hope to force an adversary within Far range to reroll an attack or damage roll.

classFeatures.name: Prestidigitation
classFeatures.description: You can perform harmless, subtle magical effects at will. For example, you can change an object's color, create a smell, light a candle, cause a tiny object to float, illuminate a room, or repair a small object.

classFeatures.name: Strange Patterns
classFeatures.description: Choose a number between 1 and 12. When you roll that number on a Duality Die, gain a Hope or clear a Stress. You can change this number when you take a long rest.

foundation.name: Prepared
foundation.description: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

foundation.name: Adept
foundation.description: When you Utilize an Experience, mark a Stress instead of spending a Hope to double your Experience modifier for that roll.

specialization.name: Accomplished
specialization.description: Take another additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

specialization.name: Perfect Recall
specialization.description: Once per rest, when you recall a domain card from your vault, reduce its Recall Cost by 1.

mastery.name: Brilliant
mastery.description: Take yet another additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

mastery.name: Honed Expertise
mastery.description: When you use an Experience, roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, you can use the Experience without spending a Hope.

foundation.name: Battlemage
foundation.description: You gain an additional Hit Point slot.

foundation.name: Face Your Fear
foundation.description: When you succeed with Fear on an attack roll, deal an extra 1d10 magic damage.

specialization.name: Conjure Shield
specialization.description: While you have at least 2 Hope, add your Proficiency to your Evasion.

specialization.name: Fueled by Fear
specialization.description: The extra damage from Face Your Fear increases to 2d10.

mastery.name: Thrive in Chaos
mastery.description: When you succeed on an attack, mark a Stress after rolling damage to force the target to mark an additional Hit Point.

mastery.name: Have No Fear
mastery.description: The extra damage from Face Your Fear increases to 3d10.

backgroundQuestions: What responsibilities did your community once count on you for? How did you let them down?
You've spent your life searching for a book or object of great significance. What is it, and why is it so important to you?
You have a powerful rival. Who are they, and why are you so determined to defeat them?
connectionQuestions: What favor have I asked of you that you're not sure you can fulfill?
What weird hobby or strange fascination do we both share?
What secret about yourself have you entrusted only to me?
